copy.curiosityHook: When territorial treaties hand the settlement over to hostile forces, how long can a sanctuary built on faith stand against imperial aggression?
copy.description: In the 18th-century South American wilderness, a Spanish Jesuit establishes a remote mission among the Guaraní. After a slave hunter undergoes a conversion and joins the work, colonial powers threaten to raze it all.
copy.vibeSummary: A thoughtful, emotionally heavy historical adventure paced with deliberate gravitas and high dramatic stakes.
copy.whyWatch: Roland Joffé directs a sweeping historical drama where personal redemption collides with colonial warfare, staging epic moral questions across a striking natural landscape.

allowedMaterial: Jesuit establishment of the South American wilderness mission
Conversion and partnership of the former slave hunter
Colonial territorial transfer between Spain and Portugal
Impending violent defense of the mission
excludedMaterial: Final fate of the mission and its defenders
Climactic battle casualties and character deaths
